notes: Fires for files created or modified in a library (properties only, no content).
Replace table with the library env var parameter, for example @parameters('Source Uploads library (tr_SourceUploadsLibrary)').
{Identifier} feeds the id of GetFileMetadata and GetFileContent. ID is the file's list item ID and survives renames.
Add runtimeConfiguration.concurrency.runs: 1 on the trigger when runs must not overlap.
Never write to the trigger's own library from the same flow: each write fires the trigger again.
